newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Datacraft sees year growth over 35 pct.
newsitem.headline: Datacraft sees year growth over 35 pct.

text.p: High technology communications company Datacraft Asia Ltd said on Thursday it expected its business revenues to show a growth of more than 35 percent year-on-year when it reported its full-year results.
Datacraft said in a statement with its half-year results that market conditions remained "buoyant".

"The group expects continued growth in its existing markets as well as expanding geographic coverage. Full-year growth is expected to be ahead of industry growth and to exceed our previous forecasts of 30-35 percent growth," it said.
Finance director Victor Yung told Reuters this meant the company expected its revenue to grow in excess of 35 percent year-on-year.
The company earlier reported a 75 percent increase in its half-year net profit to US$4.64 million.
